integrity: One necessary-and-sufficient characterization, a counting bijection, and direct finite comparisons are included; there is no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact sum can have exponentially many total dominating root subsets.
Novelty assessment cannot exclude unindexed, unpublished, or differently formulated previous enumerations.
Finite tests corroborate but do not prove the universal identity.
title: Identifying-code polynomial of one-leaf coronas by total domination and true twins
